svg.title: Red Relief Over White
svg.desc: Interpretive study from a visually inspected primary gallery photograph. Approximate geometry and interpretive palette. Photograph perspective, shadows and texture omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://matthewmarks.com/exhibitions/ellsworth-kelly-at-ninety-05-2013/lightbox/works/red-relief-over-white-2012-37111; inspected 2026-10-27. This editable vector is a study, not a facsimile.
